fields.description: Issue includes local investigative and civic reporting and columns. Major stories discuss alleged abusive practices connected with a Federal Savings & Loan Association loan arranged through the Home Owners' Loan Corporation; coverage of tax-deed and tax-lien disputes involving W. H. Garrison and municipal finances; and political coverage of the upcoming Hialeah municipal election. The issue also features Miami Beach public-safety reporting on traffic accidents and proposals for a driver's license law, along with nightlife and entertainment items (including night club licensing), society notes, and promotional material for a working-girl beauty contest.
